payload.stem: Which of the following best describes the postcondition of the method steps (what is true about the returned value when the method finishes)?

options.text: It returns how many times 4 can be subtracted from n before the remaining value is less than 4; this is the quotient n / 4.
options.why: The loop subtracts 4 until fewer than 4 remain and counts the subtractions, which equals n / 4 using integer division.

options.text: It returns the remainder when n is divided by 4.
options.why: The loop counts subtractions in c; the remainder is the final value of n, which is not returned.
The loop keeps subtracting while at least 4 remain, and the method returns the count rather than a value related to n minus 4.

options.text: It returns the number of digits in n written in base 4.
options.why: The loop does not divide repeatedly; it subtracts once per pass, which is not the digit count.
